title: New Releases: KR Art and History Museum Tileset , Tyler Warren RPG Battlers - 11th - Little Monsters and Robots 2

posts.author: RPGMakerWeb
posts.body:
A new tileset from Kokoro Reflections! New battlers from Tyler Warren!
​
Create an art gallery for your hero to take a partner for a lovely date or have your party run through dark halls and between towering displays with the KR Art and History Museum Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with another awesome modern tileset for MV/MZ, offering up a selection of displays ready to make natural history museums, art galleries, science museums, and more! A1, A2, and A4 autotiles can make neutral backdrops for your museums so that each room’s exhibits get all the attention they deserve. Set up information signs in front of glass display cases filled with bones, spaceship models, and ancient artifacts, or fill walls with detailed paintings and open floors with carefully carved statues! Even if your game doesn’t take place in a modern world, you’ll likely find useful weapons and outfits for your equipment shops and gilded art to add some extra bling to your castles and dungeons.
This pack also includes 8 character sheets to add doors and other decorations to your museums. Have the interior pool shoot water into the air at set times for a neat display and have your players enter new wings through tall glass doors. Hide bathrooms and back offices behind solid white doors, and travel to new floors in style with diagonal escalators! Set up turnstiles that will open only if your players buy tickets, or use the turnstiles to slow down monsters that are chasing your unlucky night security guard! If you want some gorgeous art to decorate castle walls, a museum for your hero to train their brain, or just some cool dinosaur skeletons, pick up the KR Art and History Museum Tileset!

​
Battle even more adorably awful monsters with the Tyler Warren RPG Battlers - 11th - Little Monsters and Robots 2 pack! Tyler Warren’s second addition to his Little Monster and Robots series is here with 40 more battler images so your heroes can face off against even more unique creatures in Tyler’s amazing colored pencil art style! Fight inky purple creatures that ooze out of shadows, technicolor bugs and evolving pink slime in forests and caves, robots that stalk sci-fi stations and are controlled by what may have once been a head in a jar, and more with this pack!
Each enemy comes in multiple sizes, so you could create a pack of small sky jellyfish with one large tentacled monster controlling the rest of them from the back lines or give your players a visual clue that a battle against a huge skeleton draped in blue robes is going to be harder than normal. Not only that, but each monster also comes in a filtered version for a smoother look to their design as well as pixel art versions in 9 different color palettes (included ones inspired by GameBoy, NES, and Time Fantasy) so you could have the same monsters in different digital worlds or upgrade the palette of your monsters as they get stronger and gain more skills as the game goes on!
This pack also includes faceset images for each battler, in various sizes to fit your favorite RPG Maker engine, so they can taunt your heroes during battles or give up important plot points after they’re defeated. Pick up the Tyler Warren RPG Battlers - 11th - Little Monsters and Robots 2 pack and send your heroes against waves of all new foes!
